name: zileuton
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hepatotoxicity: Elevations of one or more hepatic function enzymes and bilirubin may occur with zileuton extended-release tablets. Assess hepatic function enzymes prior to initiation of zileuton extended-release tablets, monthly for the first 3 months, every 2 to 3 months
